name: Kiril Kirkov PDF Invoice Manager
author: Kiril Kirkov

sections.description:
Powerful Invoice Generator for WordPress — works standalone or with WooCommerce. Accept Stripe payments directly from invoices, automate periodic invoicing, Invoices API integration, and manage currency exchange effortlessly.

📌 Features included:

  • Multiple invoice types like “Pro-Forma”, “Invoice”, “Debit note” and “Credit note”
  • Seamless Integration with WooCommerce or Standalone usage
  • Wide Range of Templates – Discover a plethora of professionally designed invoice templates at your fingertips
  • Effortless Amount Calculation – Enjoy the convenience of automatic amount calculation with our advanced functionality
  • Periodic invoicing – Streamline your invoicing process and never miss another billing cycle with this cutting-edge addition to our WordPress plugin
  • Stripe Payments with invoices unique link (in Premium version)
  • Currency Exchange (in Premium version)
  • Invoices export in CSV
  • Analytics of issued invoices
  • Generate and download invoices in PDF
  • Automatic or manual invoices amounts calculation
  • Fully translatable
  • Predefined clients
  • Predefined products
  • API Integration (in Premium version)
  • many more customization options..

Intuitive and Powerful Interface

Source code of used javascript libraries:
– ChartJS – https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
– MathJS – https://github.com/josdejong/mathjs
– kurkle/color – https://github.com/kurkle/color
– Select2 – https://github.com/select2/select2

The link is displayed in the plugin’s admin interface to inform users about
the availability of additional features in the premium version. No data is sent

sections.installation:
1. Install “Invoice Generator for WordPress & WooCommerce – PDF & Periodic Invoices” from the WordPress Plugin Directory. Or, if that doesn’t work:
  2. Unzip the plugin file and move it to the directory of your WordPress plugins – “wp-content/plugins”.
  3. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins and activate “Invoice Generator for WordPress & WooCommerce – PDF & Periodic Invoices”
sections.faq:
Does this work without WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin works standalone or with WooCommerce integration.

Is Stripe payment integration available?

Stripe payments are available in the Premium version of the plugin.
